name: Fiveheads Soccer 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Fiveheads Soccer is an exhilarating sports soccer game that invites players to select their favorite nation from the 'FiveHeads' roster and showcase their skills on the pitch. Boasting 32 world-class teams and 64 unique players, this game offers an immersive World Cup experience.
